value.rationale: The motivating projection theorem requires a potentially different translation for each plane. The natural geometric question of whether a single ambient translation simultaneously centers all plane projections is solved negatively and sharply, with a unique best global center, exact unavoidable sup-norm and root-mean-square mismatch, and full exceptional normal sets. This is structural reconstruction/coherence information not supplied by the qualitative existence or translation-invariant brightness literature; the formula extends to the full harmonic-cubic class.
